status: Necessary-route optimization; one-hour scaled-cost candidate is sensitivity only, not adopted costs. Excludes exploration, finite supply, combat and waste stalls
assumption: 5 seconds for one node plus its first connection; 2.5 seconds per additional connection. No planning time. 50% support-node allowance and 1.5 connections per total node.
method: Uniform-rate sweep followed by three coordinate-descent passes across six tier rates; grid-local optimum, not proof of global optimality
